Subject: Re: Initial pricing asks and next steps

Samir — appreciate the export. High level answers up front, then a concrete proposal attached.

Summary: based on the profile you shared, a blended monthly commit is the right path to capture chat+embeddings efficiency while avoiding high overage surprises. We typically price by model family (standard vs premium) with a model multiplier for premium inference to reflect extra compute / quality. A couple of bullets: 
- Baseline hosted per-token list: standard chat $0.0006 / 1k tokens, premium chat $0.0025 / 1k tokens.
- Embeddings baseline: $0.0011 / 1k tokens for standard embeddings, premium embeddings $0.0028 / 1k tokens (higher for larger-dimension vectors).
- We offer step discounts for commits: 0–$50k/mo (list), $50k–$200k/mo (5–12% discount), $200k–$500k/mo (12–22%), >$500k/mo (consult).

Concrete proposal (see attached SOW v2):
- 12-month blended commit: $250k/month (covers chat + embeddings).
- Model multiplier: premium models charged at 3.8x the standard rate inside the commit (equivalent to $0.0095 / 1k tokens applied to consumption designated as premium).
- Embedding bundle: any embedding usage > 100M tokens/month gets an additional 8% off embedded pricing.
- Overage cap: 20% of committed spend per month before automatic credit discussions.
- True-up: quarterly usage true-up and ability to increase commit tiers with retroactive tier discounts backfilled to start of quarter.

I'll loop Neha from pricing to check margin and see if we can tighten the multiplier.

Thanks,
Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Message 3/6
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial pricing asks and next steps

Jordan / Marissa — reviewed the numbers. A few internal constraints and one alternative: 

Constraints: 
- We can go to 3.5x multiplier for premium models (not 3.8) if the commit is >= $250k/month and the customer commits to a 12-month minimum.
- Embedding additional discount (8%) needs to be tied to an actual threshold by token, not spend — recommend 100M tokens/month threshold as you suggested.
- Overage cap of 20% is fine but we should add a hard overage protection for first 2 months when onboarding (50% cap) while caching warms.

Alternative (margin-friendly): 
- Instead of a flat multiplier, bill premium inference as standard rate + model premium surcharge $0.0019 / 1k tokens. For DataWave's profile that lowers their effective per-token premium slightly but preserves margin predictability.

I'll prepare two line items in SOW: (A) multiplier path (3.5x) and (B) surcharge path ($0.0019 / 1k).
Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Senior Pricing Manager, Redwood Inference

Jordan — thanks, the proposal looks promising. A couple of redlines from procurement:
1) We need a model tiering example that maps to our real flows (e.g., query assistant uses premium chat ~15M tok/mo, analytics embedding uses standard embeddings ~40M tok/mo). Can you provide how billing would show in monthly invoice?
2) Procurement wants to cap monthly overage charges at 15% for the first six months.
3) They asked whether premium multipliers apply to streaming tokens or only completed responses.

Also — can you confirm any minimum lead time for ramping up GPU burst capacity? We might exceed committed concurrency in Q4.

Thanks, Samir

Subject: Re: Initial pricing asks and next steps

Samir — answers inline and an example invoice extract below.

1) Invoice visibility: we can break out usage lines per model family and tag by flow (you can pass a header or we can add invoice-level tag mapping). Example invoice excerpt (monthly):
- Standard chat usage: 42,000,000 tokens x $0.0006 / 1k = $25,200
- Premium chat usage: 15,000,000 tokens x effective 3.5x multiplier => effective rate $0.0021 / 1k = $31,500
- Standard embeddings: 40,000,000 tokens x $0.0011 / 1k = $44,000
- Embedding bundle discount applied (-8%): -$3,520
- Subtotal usage: $97,180 (counts toward commit)
- Commit charge applied: $250,000 (prepaid coverage)
- Overage billed (if any): billed at agreed overage rates, capped per month as discussed.

2) Overage cap: we can accept 15% cap for first six months as a concession for onboarding, then revert to 20% cap afterward.

3) Streaming vs final tokens: multiplier/surcharge applies to total billed tokens (both token streaming and final completion tokens). We'll document this clearly in SOW.

Burst capacity: we can provide a 2-week notice SLA for short-term burst via Dedicated pools; for Q4 planning we recommend forecasting 8 weeks to ensure capacity reservations.

Next steps: if procurement is good with (a) 12-month term, (b) 3.5x multiplier or surcharge option, and (c) 15% onboarding overage cap, we'll issue SOW v2 for signature.

Regards,
Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
